title: Bound local review requests and responses
preconditions: The local reviewer is serving a large Saga with comparison-scale code and coverage surfaces.

steps.action: Inspect the configured HTTP server resource limits.
steps.expected_result: Read, write, idle, and header timeouts plus the maximum header size are all finite and positive.

steps.action: Request default, maximum, and oversized pages from every comparison-scale surface.
steps.expected_result: The server caps requested rows and every maximum page remains within its byte budget.

steps.action: Follow one bounded cursor page at a time until each surface is exhausted.
steps.expected_result: Every response stays within the requested page size and continuation reaches all results without repetition.

expected_result: The local reviewer bounds inbound server resources and outbound comparison-scale response pages.
